paite: Huan kumpipa'n mi asawl a, akiang ah Juda leh Jerusalem khopi a upa tengteng asamkhawm uhi.
heading: Josiah In Biakna Dik Lou Ahihsia / (2 Kro 34.3-7,29-33)

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Judah gam a mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mi tengteng toh, siampute leh zawlneite toh, mipi tengteng toh, aneu leh alian in TOUPA' inn ah ahohtou ua; TOUPA' inn a kimu thukhun laibu a tuang thu tengteng abil ua zak in asim hi.

Khuam zul ah kumpipa adingh a, huai laibu a tuang thukhun thu hihkip ding in lungtang tengteng leh akha tengteng a TOUPA zui ding leh athupiakte, athu theihsakte, adan thusehte zui ding in TOUPA ma ah thu akhung a; huchi in mipi tengteng in leng akhunpih uhi.

Kumpipa'n siampu lianpen Hilkiah leh azom a siampute, kongkhak veng mite kiang ah TOUPA tempul sung a Baal, Asherah leh van a om tengteng a dia kibawl tui-um belsuan tengteng lakhe vek ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in Jerusalem polam, Kidron mun ah huai tengteng ahal a, avute Bethel ah apaipih hi.

Milim pathian bia siampute, Judah Kumpipate'n Judah gam khopi mun sangte a, Jerusalem kim a gimlim hal dia ana seh uh atawpsak a; Baal a dia, ni a dia, kha a dia, aksite a dia van a omte tengteng a dia gimlim hal mite leng.
TOUPA' inn a Asherah pen Jerusalem polam Kidron lui a lakhia in ahal a, asiknengawp a, anen mi vantangte han ah atheh hi.
Asherah a dia puan gan numeite omna, TOUPA' inn kiang a pasal kizuakte omna innte aphelkhe vek hi.

Judah khopi a pan siampu tengteng apikhia a, siampute'n gimlim ahalna uh Geba a pan Beer-sheba pha in ahihbuah vek a; khopi kongpi veilam pang a om khopi ukpa Joshua kongpi ah alut a kongpite a mun sangte achimsak hi.
Mun sang siampute Jerusalem a TOUPA maitam ah ahohtou kei ua, himahleh a-unaute uh lak ah tanghou silngou soh louh ane uhi.
Kuamah in atapa hiam atanu hiam Molek kiang a mei a apaisuaksak nawnlouhna ding in, Hinnom suante phaizang a Tophet ahihbuah hi.
TOUPA' inn lutna a inn huangsung a kumpipa' inn vengmi Nathan-melek dantan chin a Judah kumpipate'n nisa a dia sakol apiakte uh alamang vek a; nisa kangtalai mei in ahal hi.
Ahaz inn chial tung a Judah kumpipate'n maitam abawlte uh leh Manasseh in TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nih a maitam abawlte kumpipa'n ahihchim a, ahihnen vek a, anente Kidron lui ah apai hi.

Jerusalem ma a tatsiatna tang taklam pang a Zidonte pathian kihhuai mahmah Astoreth a dia, Ammon suante pathian kihhuai mahmah Khemosh a dia, Ammonte Pathian kihhuai mah Molek Israel kumpipa Solomon in mun sang abawlte kumpipa'n ahihbuah hi.
Milimte akitamsak vek a, Ashera ahihpuk a, huai munte ah mihing guhte akoih hi.

Huai lou leng Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam in Bethel a maitam leh Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam in abawl mun sang, huai maitam ahihchim a mun sang mei ahal in asikzan a, Ashera ahal hi.
Josiah akihei a, tang a hante amu a; huchi in han a guhte ava lasak a, huai thu Pathian mipa'n ana gen, TOUPA thu bangbang in maitam tung ah ahal a, ahihbuah hi.
Huchi in ama'n, "Huai a ka muh kua suangphuh ahia?" achi a; khomite'n, “Pathian mipa, Judah gam a pan hong pai, Bethel a maitam tung a tua na hih a na genkholpa han ei ve," chi in ahilh uhi.
Ama'n, "Bangmah chih kei un; kuamah in aguhte lasuan kei hen," achi hi. Huchi in aguhte Samaria gam a pan zawlnei hong paipa guhte toh bangmah achih kei uhi.
Israel Kumpipate'n TOUPA hehsak dia alam uh Samaria gam khua a mun sang inn tengteng leng Josiah in asuanmang a, Bethel a ahih vek bang geih in ahih hi.
Huchi in huai a mun sang siampu tengteng maitam tung ah athat a, huaite ah mihing guhte ahal a, Jerusalem ah akik nawnta hi.
Kumpipa'n mi tengteng kiang ah, "Hiai thukhun bu a tuang bang in TOUPA, Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang zang un," chi in thu apia hi.
heading: Josiah In Paikan Kut Azang / (2 Kro 35.1-19)

paite: Israelte tung a vaihawm mite'n vai ahawm ua kipan Israel kumpipa tengteng, Judah kumpipate lal sung hun teng in huchibang hial Paikan Ankuang azang ngei nai kei uhi.
Kumpipa Josiah lal akum sawm-le-giatna kum in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in hiai bang in Paikan Ankuang anei phet uhi.

Huai ban ah TOUPA' inn a siampu Hilkiah in amuh laibu a thu tuangte akipsak theihna ding in dawi aisan siam zawlte, bumsiamte, pathian limte, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a thilkihhuai amuh tengteng Josiah in ahihmang vek hi.
heading: Josiah In Akhek Dangte

paite: Mosi Dan tengteng alungtang leh kha tengteng leh hatna tengteng a TOUPA pom amah bang mahmah ama a kumpipate kuamah a-om kei ua; anung in leng amah bang kuamah a-om nawn sam kei hi.
Huchipi in leng TOUPA'N athangpaihna thupi mahmah, Manasseh in ana thangpaihsakna tengteng ziak in Judah tung a athangpaihna akiheisan kei hi.
TOUPA'N, “Israel ka suanmang bang in Judah leng ka muhphaklouhna ah ka suanmang sam dia, hiai khua ka tel Jerusalem ngei leh huai a inn ka min a-omna ding, ka chih ka paimang ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Josiah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah tuang ahi kei maw?
heading: Josiah Vaihawm Tawpna / (2 Kro 35.20-36.1)

paite: Amah alal lai in Assuria kumpipa dou ding in Euphrates Luipi ah Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh Neko ahohtou hi. Kumpipa Josiah in amah ana dou a; ama'n amuhtak in Meggiddo ah athat hi.

Huchi in asikhate'n Meggiddo a pan aluang kangtalai in apaipih ua, Jerusalem ah alutpih ua, ama han ah avui uh. Huchi in huai gam a mite'n Josiah tapa Jehoahaz api ua, thau anilh ua, apa sik in kumpipa in abawlta uhi.
Jehoahaz alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-thum a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kha thum sung alal a; anu min Hemutal, Libnah a Jeremiah tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoahaz / (2 Kro 36.2-4)

paite: Api-le-pute hih bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
Pharaoh Neko in Jerusalem a vaihawm thei nawn lou ding in Hamath gam a Riblah ah akoltangsak a; agam uh dangka talent zakhat leh dangka-eng talent khat siah akipesak hi.
Pharaoh Neko in Josiah tapa Eliakim, apa Josiah sik in alalsak a, amin Jehoiakim chi in akheksak hi. Jehoahaz bel apimang a; Aigupta gam ah apai a, huai ah asita hi.

Jehoiakim in dangka leh dangka-eng Pharaoh ape phot a; himahleh Pharaoh thupiak bang a dangka apiakna ding in agam siah aliausak hi. Pharaoh Neko kiang a piak ding in michih liau dia aseh zah chiat bang in huai gam a mite dangka leh dangka-eng aliausak hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim / (2 Kro 36.5-8)

paite: Jehoiakim alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat alal a; anu min Zebudah, Rumah a Pedaiah tanu ahi.
Huchi in api-le-pute hihdan bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
